usageNote: 日常英式口语问句，问别人有没有某样东西，'got'比'have'更随意，朋友间聊天超自然！

examples.en: Have you got red trousers? I need to borrow a pair for the costume party!
examples.zh: 你有红色裤子吗？我需要借一条去参加主题派对！

examples.en: Have you got red trousers in size medium? I've been searching everywhere.
examples.zh: 你有中号的红色裤子吗？我找了好久了。
